Important!
If CUCM is enabled for refresh tokens and 401 is received from CUC, then CUCM token will be automatically invalidated. This is as per design.

There could be multiple reasons for this error:
Case 1 – The CUC Web Application Password is incorrect, has expired or is about to expire.
Case 2 - The CUC User have the "User Must Change at Next Sign-In' option checked.
Case 3 – The User doesn't have any Unity Connection Account.
Case 4 - If refresh tokens used - OAuth encryption & signing keys might not be correct (or not sync).

pattern.description:
UPN enabled and retrieved: {{ UpnRetrieved }}



What is UPN?

-applicable for clients running on Windows OS connected to a domain

-User Principal Name (UPN) is the name of a system user in an e-mail address format

-client can auto-discover the UPN (e.g. user@cisco.com) and use the domain part for Service Discovery process = DNS SRV lookups (e.g. _cisco-uds.cisco.com)


Advantage:

-Domain is taken from UPN user and user is not prompted for email address.


Drawback:

-This bound to this specific domain only, user is not be able to login with different domain.


How to disable:

-MSI transform: UPN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false

annotation.template:
UPN enabled and retrieved: {{ UpnRetrieved }}



What is UPN?

-applicable for clients running on Windows OS connected to a domain

-User Principal Name (UPN) is the name of a system user in an e-mail address format

-client can auto-discover the UPN (e.g. user@cisco.com) and use the domain part for Service Discovery process = DNS SRV lookups (e.g. _cisco-uds.cisco.com)


Advantage:

-Domain is taken from UPN user and user is not prompted for email address.


Drawback:

-This bound to this specific domain only, user is not be able to login with different domain.


How to disable:

-MSI transform: UPN_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=false

b) External DB scheme has been created and is reachable
c) Cisco XCP Text Conference Manager is running
d) Cisco XCP Router has been restarted afterwards

Client Support - if false, Jabber client needs to be enabled for Persistent Chatrooms in the jabber-config.xml - key: Persistent_Chat_Enabled set to true - Check Parameters Reference Guide for Cisco Jabber for more details.
